description:
📚 Math – Number System (Unit Digit nikalne ki Short Tricks)

📝 Chapter Summary:
Kisi bhi number ke घातांक (Powers) ka **Unit Digit (इकाई का अंक)** ya **Last Digit** chuktiyon mein find karne ke liye math ke rules ko 3 magic super-groups mein divide kiya gaya hai. Inhe yaad rakhkar aap exam mein bina pen uthaye answer de sakte hain.

🔥 Super Group 1: "No Change" Gang (0, 1, 5, 6 Rules)

Agar kisi number ke end (unit place) par niche diye gaye digits hon, to uski power chahe kitni bhi badi kyu na ho, **Unit Digit kabhi nahi badalta (Always remains same)**:

  • 🎯 Digit [0] ➔ Every power ends with 0.
    Example: 102 ➔ 0, 305 ➔ 0
  • 🎯 Digit [1] ➔ Every power ends with 1.
    Example: 117 ➔ 1
  • 🎯 Digit [5] ➔ Every power ends with 5.
    Example: 259 ➔ 5
  • 🎯 Digit [6] ➔ Every power ends with 6.
    Example: 1610 ➔ 6
💡 Super Memory Code: "0156 No Change" Yaani dimag mein bitha lijiye ki 0, 1, 5, 6 ki power kuch bhi ho, answer same to same rahega!

🔥 Super Group 2: "Odd / Even" Gang (4 & 9 Shortcuts)

Digits 4 aur 9 ka cyclicity (चक्र) sirf 2 ka hota hai. Inke liye power ka **Odd (विषम)** ya **Even (सम)** check karna hi kafi hai:

Base Unit Digit If Power is Odd (विषम घात) If Power is Even (सम घात) Quick Examples
Digit 4 Answer always 4 Answer always 6 41 ➔ 4, 43 ➔ 4
42 ➔ 6, 44 ➔ 6
Digit 9 Answer always 9 Answer always 1 91 ➔ 9, 93 ➔ 9
92 ➔ 1, 94 ➔ 1

🔄 Super Group 3: "Cyclicity of 4" Gang (2, 3, 7, 8 Rules)

Digits 2, 3, 7, aur 8 ka cycle 4 ka hota hai, yaani har 4 powers ke baad unit digit repeat hota hai.

  • ⚙️ Master Rule: Simply perform (Power ÷ 4) aur jo Remainder (शेषफल) bache, use hi new power mankar answer nikal lo.
  • ⚠️ Special Note: Agar power 4 se fully divide ho jaye (Remainder = 0), to power ki jagah hamesha 4 use karein.
Unit Digit Power 1 (Remainder = 1) Power 2 (Remainder = 2) Power 3 (Remainder = 3) Power 4 (Remainder = 0)
Powers of 2 21 ➔ 2 22 ➔ 4 23 ➔ 8 24 ➔ 6
Powers of 3 31 ➔ 3 32 ➔ 9 33 ➔ 7 34 ➔ 1
Powers of 7 71 ➔ 7 72 ➔ 9 73 ➔ 3 74 ➔ 1
Powers of 8 81 ➔ 8 82 ➔ 4 83 ➔ 2 84 ➔ 6

📐 Mod Trick Matrix (an mod 10 Method)

Mathematical term mein last digit search karna aur mod 10 (10 se divide karke remainder nikalna) bilkul same chiz hai.

Evaluation Dimension Logical Modulus Step-by-Step Formula
an mod 10 Rule Number ka sirf last digit lo ➔ Power ke last 2 digits ko 4 se divide karo ➔ Remainder apply karke value nikal lo.

🚀 Live Solved Example: Find last digit of 122173

Step 1: 122 ≡ 2 (mod 10) -> Baaki numbers chodo, sirf unit digit '2' lo.
Step 2: Power 173 ke last two digits (73) ko 4 se divide karo -> 73 ÷ 4 = 18 (Remainder = 1)
Step 3: Now apply remainder as power: 21 = 2
🎯 Final Answer = 2

🧠 Quick Revision Checklist (Mind Tool)

  • ✅ 0, 1, 5, 6 dekhte hi bina soche same to same digit likh do.
  • ✅ 4 ki power Odd to 4, Even to 6.
  • ✅ 9 की power Odd to 9, Even to 1.
  • ✅ 2, 3, 7, 8 aane par power ke last 2 digits ko 4 se kato aur remainder ko power bana do!
